name: B47ANCE'd UI

features.text: Public Lua client API 1: styled native controls, renderer, layout, dialogs, focus and bounded tooltips.
Near-black shared surfaces, grey default accent and instance-rounded corners; explicit Small/Normal button helpers preserve existing geometry and native callbacks. Legacy Large calls alias Normal.
Separate large-text MenuButton component for consumer-owned main/pause-style navigation; transparent backing, no button frame, label-only scoped accent hover/controller focus.

Native main/Esc navigation adapter: large text with scoped accent hover/controller underline, preserving native label identities, actions, visibility, controller rows (the separate background adapter lays out the main-menu column). No global class override or tick scan.

Security-room main menu: four independent 1-60 second static startups then persistent no-signal loops; enlarged centered labels with visible direct mod-entry discovery and responsive rows, retaining callbacks.
Main-menu-only runtime music gain mute; saved options unchanged and native exit restores configured gain. Audible rain/thunder suppression NOT TESTED.

Recomposed security room with one continuous wall, pipe run, floor perspective and lamp; uniform cover scaling through 32:9, four transparent CRT interiors and a left menu column. PZ runtime NOT TESTED.
In-game hex/RGB accent editor with live scoped preview, per-consumer/local-player persistence, opacity-only migration and reset to grey.
Consumer/player scoped local appearance with legacy import, lazy appearance editor and original clipboard drawing.
Live CCTV camera feeds, full vanilla UI overhaul and advanced layout editor remain unimplemented.
Public Workshop MP test item 3822582242 updated to 0.3.0-dev.1 with source/package/stage parity and independent public description verification; native/dedicated NOT TESTED.

limits: 0.5.0-dev.4 development source only; Workshop remains 0.3.0-dev.1. 0.5.0-dev.2 visual menu was observed in an isolated local game profile; 0.5.0-dev.4 audio and ultrawide layout runtime NOT TESTED. Other main-menu render replacements are skipped. Offline tests do not establish native, controller, split-screen or dedicated acceptance. G7/stable G8 BLOCKED. Lua-only local presentation; no gameplay ownership.
